title: AWS Makes Graviton5 Memory-Optimized Instances Generally Available
dek: Amazon’s new R9g and R9gd EC2 instances bring Graviton5 processors to memory-optimized workloads, with AWS claiming up to 25% better compute performance than the prior R8g generation.
socialCaption: AWS has made Graviton5-based R9g and R9gd memory-optimized EC2 instances generally available. AWS cites up to 25% better compute performance than R8g for workloads such as databases, caches and real-time analytics. The operational task now is benchmarking Arm compatibility, latency and total cost.
